title: Point mqtt_soft_mutex.feature at Level 2 epic kbs-dab765 (or add MQTT Gherkin story)
description:
SD nit #1 on PR #278: mqtt_soft_mutex.feature is mapped to protocol epic kbs-c29c46 rather than Level 2 epic kbs-dab765, and there is no dedicated MQTT Gherkin story id.

Fix: add a Gherkin story under kbs-dab765 and cite it from the feature, or retarget the existing file.
right_now_summary: The MQTT feature still points to the wrong epic and lacks a dedicated Gherkin story.
